content: mike42/escpos-php v4.0 (2022-05-23, packagist). Stable, 2.8k stars, supports Epson ESC/POS thermal printers over USB/Serial/Ethernet/SMB/CUPS. Requires PHP 7.3+, intl, json, zlib. Methods: text, cut, barcode, qrCode, graphics, setJustification, pulse (cash drawer). For server-side raw receipt printing. For browser-only POS, window.print() of a styled receipt HTML + @media print CSS is simpler and printer-agnostic but less control. Library is unmaintained-ish (last release 2022) but protocol is stable.
